title: Fix uncompress leaks
description:
# Summary

- Fix memory leaks of return of calls to `tvb_uncompress*`
  - Applies to `mysql`, `gelf`, `mcpe`, `multipart`, `rtps`, and `sip`.
- Note requirement to free return in `tvb_uncompress*` functions.

# Background & Motivation

Callers of `tvb_uncompress*` may leak the returned `tvbuff_t`.

## Tests

The following are test files and leak reports. I was unable to find test files for `mcpe`, `rtps`, or `sip`.

### mysql

[mysql_compress.pcap](/uploads/ef1092470187ab7c7da505abbafdc412/mysql_compress.pcap) comes from: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/10342

```
$ valgrind --leak-check=full \
        ./build/run/tshark -r .h/mysql_compress.pcap -V -d tcp.port==5619,mysql
```

### rtps

The call to `tvb_uncompress` in `packet-rtps.c` was added in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/commit/d4c9dbd2b765f620baac762b71cf04254e9e717c. I was unable to find a packet capture with compressed RTPS.

### sip

The call to `tvb_uncompress` in `packet-sip.c` was added in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/commit/bba21ab84f47cbe93331dcc7abb7d46799765bdc. I was unable to find a packet capture with compressed SIP.

notes.body: Maybe add a line like "You probably want tvb_child_uncompress instead" to these and the others.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9236/diffs?diff_id=573213112&start_sha=49bcaa8dcae1d049e1db5051be7473b8827fd9c4#beff67078bc08961174b41dbd8c44fbe567577c6_1024_1024)
Huh, this pre-existing comment should be "attached to parent" not "attached to _tvb_", for this and all the others.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9236/diffs?diff_id=573213112&start_sha=49bcaa8dcae1d049e1db5051be7473b8827fd9c4#beff67078bc08961174b41dbd8c44fbe567577c6_1031_1032)
Looks correct. The set of use cases where people actually want the version that doesn't free the new tvb is small, good catch here.

@@ -1019,13 +1019,17 @@ WS_DLL_PUBLIC gint tvb_find_tvb(tvbuff_t *haystack_tvb, tvbuff_t *needle_tvb,
  * Uncompresses a zlib compressed packet inside a tvbuff at offset with
  * length comprlen.  Returns an uncompressed tvbuffer if uncompression
  * succeeded or NULL if uncompression failed.
+ *
+ * The returned tvbuffer must be freed with `tvb_free` or added to the
+ * chain of another tvbuffer to avoid a memory leak. Consider using
+ * tvb_child_uncompress to simplify memory management.
  */
 WS_DLL_PUBLIC tvbuff_t *tvb_uncompress(tvbuff_t *tvb, const int offset,
     int comprlen);
 
 /**
  * Uncompresses a zlib compressed packet inside a tvbuff at offset with
- * length comprlen.  Returns an uncompressed tvbuffer attached to tvb if
+ * length comprlen.  Returns an uncompressed tvbuffer attached to parent if
  * uncompression succeeded or NULL if uncompression failed.
  */
